## Problem and behavior

Explain the user-visible problem and the change.

## Validation

List commands/results and live Mattermost versions/topology if tested. Mark unrun checks explicitly.

## Compatibility and privacy

- [ ] Plugin ID, author-only access, deduplication and first timestamp preserved or migration explained.
- [ ] No credentials, production identifiers or real viewer data included.
- [ ] Retention, HA, upgrade/rollback and documentation impact considered.
- [ ] License/third-party notices retained.
